# BCR knowledge backup fixtures

These small ZIPs were generated by the existing `writeKnowledgeBackup` export
function in `/home/zs/workspace/bcr/apps/studio/src/knowledge/storage/backup.ts`,
using its `@zip.js/zip.js` writer. They exercise real BCR frontmatter, ZIP data
descriptors and layout rather than a second encoder's approximation.

- `bcr-v2.zip`: one Chinese note, stable id and logical path, empty citations.
- `bcr-v4.zip`: the same note with one Reader citation, collection, explicit
  folders and a small text attachment.

The note in v2 has id `source-note-1`, body
`# 资产配置\n\n权益仓位上限为 60%。\n`, and BCR BLAKE3 revision
`3b8eda31d04e9dd9a13c1fabbd23b87d7c5c3910e72791fe393b598f76de4713`.
Navi intentionally computes an independent, explicitly prefixed SHA-256 snapshot
fingerprint rather than claiming compatibility with that revision algorithm.

Neither fixture contains user data, credentials or a real Reader document.
